frontier_black_market.title: The Frontier Market
frontier_black_market.desc: A spy report details an illicit trade outside the Great Wall: General Huo's subordinates melt down obsolete imperial iron plates in exchange for northern horses and furs. At the bottom, Huo's own brush scrawls: 'Starving soldiers cannot fight barbarians.'

tolerate.text: Turn a blind eye and let the gray revenue subsidize the army
tolerate.outcome: The imperial treasury gains a stealthy cut, and the northern garrison acquires fresh mounts. Huo offers no effusive thanks, yet victory reports from the frontier grow unusually frequent.

ban_strict.text: Issue a stern reprimand and order Huo to stamp out the market within three days
ban_strict.outcome: The black market is burned to cinders, choking off the garrison's extra grease. Huo sneers in the envoy's face, reducing future frontier memorials to cold, bare numbers.

frontier_snow_storm.title: The White Disaster
frontier_snow_storm.desc: A blinding December blizzard locks down the northern pass. Huo's urgent dispatch arrives at the cost of three spent horses: padded winter gear is lacking, over a hundred men have frozen to death, and mutiny brews in the drifts.

drain_vault.text: Grit your teeth, squeeze 300,000 taels from the vault, and rush winter supplies north
drain_vault.outcome: Supply wagons brave the howling gale. A fortnight later, a blood-inked scroll arrives from the gate, stamped with the thumbprints of every commander. The frontier holds, but your coffers are bare.

ignore_storm.text: Command them to hold their posts at all costs; the court has nothing to spare
ignore_storm.outcome: The snow buries a suppressed uprising along with the frostbitten dead. A gaping tear forms in the northwestern defense line, and everyone knows what follows.
